test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a salient feature of Fundamental Duties of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: There is clear difference between Fundamental Rights and Fundamental Duties.
Fundamental Duties are both civic and moral in nature.
They are enforceable by law and can be challenged in court.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**They are enforceable by law and can be challenged in court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties** in the Indian Constitution are listed in **Article 51A** under Part IV-A.
 
• These duties were added by the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**, inspired by the Constitution of the former **USSR**.
 
• Fundamental Duties are **non-justiciable**, meaning their implementation cannot be enforced by courts.
 
• They are designed to promote a sense of **civic responsibility** and **moral obligation** among citizens.
 
• The statement "They are enforceable by law and can be challenged in court" is incorrect because Fundamental Duties do not have legal backing to compel their adherence or challenge their violation in a court of law.
 
• Though non-justiciable, these duties serve as a reminder to citizens to uphold **national values** and act as a guiding principle for the **legislature** in framing laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **It is non-justiciable.**__

 __
 
• The Fundamental Duties are explicitly **non-justiciable**, meaning their violation cannot be challenged in a court of law.
 
• This characteristic distinguishes them from **Fundamental Rights**, which are enforceable in courts.
 
 
 
• **There is clear difference between Fundamental Rights and Fundamental Duties.**__
 __
 
• **Fundamental Rights** focus on individual freedoms and liberties, whereas **Fundamental Duties** emphasize responsibilities and obligations towards the nation.
 
• Fundamental Rights are enforceable in a court of law, while Duties are non-enforceable.
 
 
 
• **Fundamental Duties are both civic and moral in nature.**__
 
 
• These duties reflect a blend of **civic responsibilities** such as respecting the Constitution and **moral obligations** like protecting the environment.
 
• They aim to instill a sense of **national pride** and moral consciousness among citizens.
